title: PowerGrid: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common PowerGrid failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If machines stall, check generator fuel, cable continuity, voltage tier, storage level, breaker state, and consumer demand. Most outages are a missing link or overloaded segment.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If machines stall, check fuel, cable continuity, voltage or tier, storage level, breaker state, and the last thing you added before the outage.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Recovery Anchor
blocks.body: Use this to test the smallest fix before changing the whole route.
